title: Bound on a binary prefix value
statement: For every Boolean sequence $f:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and every natural number $i$, its weighted prefix value on positions below $i$ is strictly less than $2^i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean sequence indexed by natural numbers
